title: Paid Time Off (PTO)
body: Full-time employees accrue 15 days of PTO per year, credited monthly. Unused PTO up to 5 days may be carried over into the next calendar year. Submit requests at least 5 business days in advance via the Leave tab.

title: Payroll Schedule
body: Employees are paid on a bi-weekly basis, every other Friday. Direct deposit is required. Pay stubs are available in the payroll portal by 9am on payday.

title: Health & Dental Benefits
body: PeopleHub covers 80% of health insurance premiums and 100% of dental premiums for employees. Dependents can be added during open enrollment or within 30 days of a qualifying life event.

title: Remote Work Policy
body: Employees may work remotely up to 3 days per week with manager approval. Fully remote arrangements require VP-level sign-off and are evaluated on a role-by-role basis.

title: Wellness Reimbursement
body: Employees can be reimbursed up to $300 per calendar year for gym memberships, fitness classes, or approved wellness apps. Submit receipts through the expense portal under 'Wellness'.

title: Code of Conduct
body: All employees are expected to act with integrity, respect, and professionalism. Harassment, discrimination, and retaliation of any kind are strictly prohibited and should be reported to HR immediately.
